# TiDB Cloud

Manage TiDB Cloud Starter, Essential, Dedicated, IAM, billing, and Data Service control-plane resources.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tidb-cloud/.

## Actions

- **Get Cluster** (read-only): Get details for one Starter/Essential instance or Dedicated cluster by ID.
- **Get Monthly Bill** (read-only): Return the TiDB Cloud organization bill for one calendar month.
- **List Audit Logs** (read-only): Search TiDB Cloud organization audit logs by time range, event type, or keyword and return one page of results.
- **List Branches** (read-only): List database branches for a TiDB Cloud Starter or Essential instance.
- **List Clusters** (read-only): List TiDB Cloud Starter/Essential instances or Dedicated clusters, with product-specific filters.
- **List Data App Deployments** (read-only): List one page of deployments and deployment status for a TiDB Cloud Data Service application, plus a continuation cursor.
- **List Data Apps** (read-only): List TiDB Cloud Data Service applications in a project, returning one page and a continuation cursor.
- **List Import Tasks** (read-only): List one page of import tasks for a TiDB Cloud Starter/Essential instance or Dedicated cluster, including status, progress, source,…
- **List Organization Members** (read-only): List one page of TiDB Cloud organization members with optional identity, assignment, role, and status filters, plus a continuation cursor.
- **List Regions** (read-only): List regions available for Starter/Essential or Dedicated clusters, optionally filtering Dedicated regions.
